answer: Identity here is grown, not registered: a newcomer must be planted in an existing grove of bonded peers who stake collateral on its first tasks, each audited by a randomly drawn stranger. Because auditors rotate unpredictably, a mass-registered cluster can only vouch for itself, leaving a hollow reputation graph, a terrace walled off from the rest. A gale of fake signups then burns more collateral than those identities can earn.
